James Venning had a good start and Peter McDonald battled hard to lose just one place. He handed over to the 'Mighty Quinn' and Kevin zipped through the field to gain ten places.

Spirits were lifted higher still when James Venning stormed to a convincing victory in the under 17 race. A tough looking runner this one and we'll be keeping an eye on his progress over the next few years.
